name: Assess Coherence
description: NPT mechanism 1 (T2R rows 64/109): 'Does this routine make sense as part of your life?' Assess sense-making (meaning, differentiation, internalization) into normalization_state[]. The user defines meaning; the agent asks, never supplies.
guardrails: The user defines meaning — the agent asks, never supplies (T2R row 64).
Coherence assessment is descriptive of the user's stated framing, never an external verdict.
Internalization is inferred from user language with evidence anchors, never assumed.

name: Form CMO Hypothesis
description: Realist-eval op: form a Context-Mechanism-Outcome hypothesis for why embedding is or isn't taking hold. Outputs candidate CMO for calibration — hypothesis status (evidence-ladder claim), never verdict (Valens P4/P10 discipline).
guardrails: CMO hypotheses are hypotheses (claim level), never verdicts.
Each hypothesis carries a mechanism anchor (coherence/participation/collective action/monitoring) and evidence quote.
Hypotheses feed calibration, never autonomous action.
